cases.question: Trong Shadow of the Erdtree, Messmer the Impaler được gặp ở đâu và có phải boss bắt buộc không?

cases.question: Samurai khởi đầu có những armament nào ngoài Uchigatana?

cases.question: What warrior name does Godfrey use when he abandons his royal identity?
cases.expected_answer: He uses the name Hoarah Loux, returning to his identity as a warrior.

cases.question: Which four attributes does Radagon's Soreseal raise, and what drawback accompanies them?
cases.expected_answer: It raises Vigor, Endurance, Strength and Dexterity, but also increases damage taken. Do not invent exact bonus or damage percentages from the item description alone.

cases.question: Which ranged weapon and ammunition does Samurai start with?
cases.expected_answer: Longbow, Arrow x20 and Fire Arrow x10. Do not add an initial spell.

cases.question: Ai đã đập vỡ Elden Ring, và Radagon đã cố làm gì với nó?
cases.expected_answer: Queen Marika đập vỡ Elden Ring; Radagon cố sửa lại nó nhưng không thành công.

cases.question: Scadutree Fragment dùng ở đâu, tăng gì và có tác dụng bên ngoài Realm of Shadow không?
cases.expected_answer: Dùng Scadutree Fragment tại Sites of Grace để tăng Scadutree Blessing, giúp người mang tăng khả năng gây sát thương và giảm sát thương nhận. Blessing không có tác dụng bên ngoài Realm of Shadow; không tự thêm phần trăm của patch hiện tại.

cases.question: Arsenal Charm hỗ trợ equip load ra sao, và có thể đeo cùng Arsenal Charm +1 hoặc Great-Jar's Arsenal để cộng dồn không?

cases.question: Moonveil: đòn nhẹ và đòn nặng của Transient Moonlight khác nhau về hướng đánh và tầm ra sao?
cases.expected_answer: Đòn nhẹ quét ngang có projectile tầm ngắn; đòn nặng bổ dọc có projectile tầm trung. Không suy các con số damage hiện tại.

cases.question: Theo quy tắc level là tổng tám attribute trừ 79, nhân vật level 100 có tổng bao nhiêu điểm attribute?
cases.expected_answer: 179, tính 100+79. Không gọi 179 là số điểm được cộng thêm từ class khởi đầu.

cases.question: Tôi nên đi đâu tiếp trong Elden Ring?
cases.expected_answer: Hỏi vị trí/Grace hiện tại và mục tiêu như main story hay quest; không đoán tiến độ hoặc áp một route duy nhất.

cases.question: When Ranni and Godwyn died at the same time, what happened to Ranni's flesh and soul?
cases.expected_answer: Ranni's flesh died while her soul survived. Godwyn, in contrast, died in soul alone.

cases.question: Which affinity does Ash of War: Golden Vow grant, and who benefits from the skill described on the item?
cases.expected_answer: It grants the Sacred affinity. Its described Golden Vow skill increases attack power and defense for the user and nearby allies. Do not confuse this Ash of War's values with another Golden Vow version or invent percentages.

cases.question: Is Maliketh optional if I want to unlock Leyndell, Ashen Capital?
cases.expected_answer: No, the introduction explicitly says Maliketh must be defeated to unlock Ashen Capital and reach endgame.

cases.question: Ranni và Starscourge Radahn có quan hệ huyết thống gì? Hãy chỉ ra cha mẹ chung để giải thích.
cases.expected_answer: Họ là anh em ruột, cùng có cha là Radagon và mẹ là Rennala; Radahn là anh của Ranni.

cases.question: Vì sao Fortissax trở thành Lichdragon, và biến cố đó liên hệ thế nào với cái chết của Godwyn?
cases.expected_answer: Godwyn chết về linh hồn và trở thành Prince of Death. Fortissax chống lại Death bên trong người bạn Godwyn nhưng thất bại, rồi bị nó làm tha hóa thành Lichdragon.

cases.question: Scadutree Fragment và Revered Spirit Ash tăng blessing cho những đối tượng nào? Hai loại có dùng được ngoài Realm of Shadow không?
cases.expected_answer: Scadutree Fragment tăng Scadutree Blessing cho người mang. Revered Spirit Ash tăng Revered Spirit Ash Blessing cho summoned spirits và spectral steed. Cả hai blessing không có tác dụng ngoài Realm of Shadow; không đánh đồng chúng thành cùng một buff cho người chơi.

cases.question: Tôi muốn vào Nokron để tìm Fingerslayer Blade: cần điều kiện gì, rồi tìm rương ở đâu?
cases.expected_answer: Hạ Starscourge Radahn để mở Nokron; rương chứa Blade nằm phía đông-bắc Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace theo snapshot. Không biến đây thành chỉ dẫn từng ngã rẽ đầy đủ.

cases.question: Tôi dùng katana, hãy cho chính xác AR và DPS ở patch mới nhất.
cases.expected_answer: Thiếu weapon/upgrade/affinity/stats/conditions/patch đã xác minh; không bịa AR/DPS. Hỏi điều kiện quan trọng hoặc nói rõ chưa thể tính.

cases.question: During Ranni's quest, what key opens the chest containing the Dark Moon Ring, where is the chest, and how is the key obtained?
cases.expected_answer: The Discarded Palace Key opens the chest in Rennala's boss room at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The quest progression awards the key after defeating the Baleful Shadow beyond the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace.

cases.question: Does Samurai's Build Optimization note establish that it is universally the best starting class?
cases.expected_answer: No. It says most efficient in specific circumstances, not universally optimal.

response.answer: Blaidd the Half-Wolf là một NPC hiệp sĩ nửa sói, và anh ta phục vụ Lunar Princess Ranni với vai trò cái bóng trung thành của cô ấy [1]. Anh ta được tạo ra bởi chính Two Fingers của Ranni để làm chư hầu cho cô, được Rennala chấp thuận và nuôi dạy như em trai kế của Ranni [2]. Trong lời thoại, Blaidd tự giới thiệu mình là "sworn sword to mistress Ranni", và Ranni cũng nhắc tới "a half-wolven warrior by the name of Blaidd" trong số những người phục vụ mình [3][4]. Thanh Royal Greatsword của anh được ghi là lời thề chỉ phục vụ một mình Ranni, trái với định mệnh anh sinh ra phải theo [5].

sources.title: Blaidd the Half-Wolf
sources.text: Blaidd the Half-Wolf is an NPC in ELDEN RING (2022). He is a half-wolf warrior in service to Lunar Princess Ranni and serves as her faithful shadow.

sources.title: Blaidd the Half-Wolf
sources.text:
Blaidd was created by Ranni's own Two Fingers as a vassal to Lunar Princess Ranni and to be incapable of treachery towards her, as she was one of the three Empyreans candidates chosen by the Greater Will, along with Miquella and Malenia, to eventually replace their mother Queen Marika the Eternal as the God of a new age. However, the Two Fingers also created a failsafe within Blaidd that was unknown to him; that if Ranni should ever deny the destiny set out for her by the Greater Will and rebel against it, the loyal shadow would slowly descend into madness, which would inevitably pose a threat to Ranni herself.
He was approved by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon and became raised as Ranni's stepbrother. He was willing to descend into madness as his ultimate end to support his stepsister Ranni's will from his heart.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
After entering Ranni's service (before Radahn Festival)
Good, then I ask we proceed with haste.
There is, in my service, a half-wolven warrior by the name of Blaidd.
I would have thee join him in searching for the hidden treasure of Nokron, the Eternal City.
I have called for Blaidd to greet thee below. Take from him the particulars.
Ah, and there wilt thou find Iji, my war counselor, and Seluvis, preceptor in the sorcerous arts, also.
Heed not their peculiarities; feel secure in gaining from them what advantage thou canst.
I am sure the others will be doing just the same.

sources.title: Blaidd the Half-Wolf
sources.text:
At Ranni's Rise, if you had not spoken to him before
Ah. I heard about you. Good to finally meet.
Name's Blaidd, sworn sword to mistress Ranni.
Glad to have you aboard.
Well. Getting right to business...
I'm situated in Limgrave right now.
The eternal city of Nokron lies somewhere at the bottom of this land.
I'm planning to go below through the well in the Mistwood.
See if I can't find the road to Nokron from there...
I'm going below through the well in the Mistwood.
See if I can't find the road to Nokron...
Don't keep me waiting, eh.

sources.title: Royal Greatsword
sources.text:
Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf.
In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.

sources.title: Messmer the Impaler
sources.text: Messmer the Impaler is a mandatory boss in Shadow of the Erdtree. He is a Demigod who is encountered in the Shadow Keep.

sources.title: Bosses
sources.text:
Over two hundred bosses are available to fight, but only a few must be beaten to finish the game. These bosses are encountered after acquiring two Great Runes and gaining access to Leyndell, Royal Capital. The boss fights that are not optional and must be beaten to progress include:
Any two Shardbearers
Draconic Tree Sentinel or Fia's Champions
Godfrey, First Elden Lord
Morgott, the Omen King
Fire Giant
Godskin Duo
Maliketh, the Black Blade
Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing
Godfrey, First Elden Lord
Radagon of the Golden Order
Elden Beast
Two bosses must be defeated in order to access the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC:
Starscourge Radahn
Mohg, Lord of Blood
Similarly, the bosses mandatory for completing the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC are:
Messmer the Impaler
Romina, Saint of the Bud
Promised Consort Radahn

rows.question: What warrior name does Godfrey use when he abandons his royal identity?
rows.expected: He uses the name Hoarah Loux, returning to his identity as a warrior.

response.answer: He takes the name Hoarah Loux, "Warrior" — the identity he uses both as Badlands chieftain and in his second boss phase, where he declares "Now I fight as Hoarah Loux! Warrior!" [1][2][3]. This happens after the Long March, when he divests himself of kingship and becomes a simple warrior again [1][4].

sources.title: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
sources.text:
As the Lord of the Battlefield, Godfrey fought in many battles. During the siege of Castle Morne, Godfrey bested a lone hero who fought for vengeance. On top of leading the war against the Giants, he faced the Storm Lord alone. However, when his last enemy fell, it is said that the hue of Godfrey's eyes faded. At the end of his campaign, although his golden armies were unvanquished and unbowed, he found his Grace lost, tattered and faded. He and his warriors were addressed by Queen Marika, who informed them that she had divested them of their Grace. She commanded them to leave the Lands Between, to wage war in a land afar, where they would live and die. Thus, Godfrey and his kinfolk became the first Tarnished, and left the Lands Between together on a pilgrimage known as the Long March, at the end of which Godfrey divested himself of kingship and became a simple warrior once more.
Godfrey became a chieftain of the Badlands, under the name of Hoarah Loux. Although the head of his axe had been broken in a battle fought during the Long March, his loyal warriors honored him by wielding axes of their own, and they became the weapon of choice for Badlands chieftains.

sources.title: Badlands
sources.text:
After his banishment from the Lands Between, Lord Godfrey led his kinsfolk, the Tarnished, on a Long March, after which he divested himself of kingship and once again became a simple warrior. As Hoarah Loux, Godfrey became a chieftain of the Badlands, inspiring many brave warriors to follow his example.
Exalted Flesh is considered to be a delicacy in the Badlands, eaten by its heroes.

rows.question: Which four attributes does Radagon's Soreseal raise, and what drawback accompanies them?
rows.expected: It raises Vigor, Endurance, Strength and Dexterity, but also increases damage taken. Do not invent exact bonus or damage percentages from the item description alone.

response.answer: Radagon's Soreseal raises Vigor, Endurance, Strength and Dexterity, and in exchange it increases the damage you take by a similar measure [1]. Its stat boosts are +5 each, while the drawback works out to -15% Damage Negation [2]. That trade favors lower-level characters, since the extra Vigor, flat Defense and Equipment Load usually outweigh the penalty early on, but it becomes a liability later as enemies hit harder and your stats hit diminishing returns [2].

sources.title: Radagon's Soreseal
sources.text:
This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.
Greatly raises vigor, endurance, strength, dexterity, but also increases damage taken by a similar measure.
Solemn duty weighs upon the one beholden; not unlike a gnawing curse from which there is no deliverance.

sources.title: Radagon's Soreseal
sources.text:
Radagon's Soreseal fares best on lower level builds, but can become a bit of a trap if worn too long. In the early game, the stat increases more than make up for the extra damage taken in practice due to the high returns of HP at lower levels of Vigor, the significant bump in flat Defense from effectively being 20 levels higher, and the increased Equipment Load allowing players to wear heavier armor sooner. The increased Strength and Dexterity also have greater utility early on, when players have fewer points to spare to meet weapon requirements. However, as the player levels up their stats, they will eventually reach a point of diminishing returns, where +5 to a given stat simply doesn't provide as large an impact proportionally. Meanwhile, -15% Damage Negation only becomes an increasingly dire debuff as the player gets further into the game and enemies hit for larger and larger amounts of damage.
Once the player hits Vigor's first softcap of 40, it's better to remove the Soreseal and replace it with another talisman that provides either a percentage increase to the associated attributes or a flat stat increase without lowering Damage Negation. For example, more HP can be obtained from the Crimson Amber Medallions, more Equipment Load from the Arsenal Charms, a mixture of both boons from Erdtree's Favors, and more Strength or Dexterity from their associated Heirlooms.
Considered a variant of Radagon's Scarseal, the two cannot be equipped at the same time.
This is one of the eight talismans needed for the Legendary Talismans trophy/achievement.

rows.question: Ai đã đập vỡ Elden Ring, và Radagon đã cố làm gì với nó?
rows.expected: Queen Marika đập vỡ Elden Ring; Radagon cố sửa lại nó nhưng không thành công.

response.answer: Queen Marika là người đã đập vỡ Elden Ring bằng chiếc búa đá của mình, sau cái chết của Godwyn trong Đêm Dao Đen [1][3]. Radagon — alter ego của bà, đồng thời là Elden Lord — đã cố sửa lại chiếc nhẫn bằng chính chiếc búa đó, nhưng không thành [1][2][3]. Vì tội này, Marika bị giam trong Erdtree, còn Radagon dù chống lại bà vẫn phải chịu chung bản án vì hai người bị ràng buộc trong một cơ thể [2].

sources.title: The Shattering
sources.section: The Shattering of the Elden Ring
sources.text:
Queen Marika shattering the Elden Ring
Radagon repairing the Elden Ring
The Night of Black Knives became the catalyst for the Shattering. In response to Godwyn's death, Queen Marika the Eternal used her hammer to shatter the Elden Ring. Elden Lord Radagon, her alter ego, attempted in vain to repair the Elden Ring. As punishment for her offense, the goddess Marika was imprisoned within the Erdtree.
Consequently, the shattering of the Elden Ring corrupted the Golden Order, and lead to a Shattering War that would leave the Lands Between in ruin.

sources.title: Radagon of the Golden Order
sources.text:
Radagon trying to repair the Elden Ring.
Following the Night of Black Knives, Marika shattered the Elden Ring, breaking the Golden Order. Radagon, on the other hand, remained loyal to the Golden Order, and attempted to repair the Elden Ring with the same hammer used to shatter it. As punishment, Marika was imprisoned inside the Erdtree. While Radagon had opposed Marika's treachery, he would share Marika's sentence, as the two were now bound in a single body.
When a Tarnished sets fire to the Erdtree in order to burn away the wall of thorns denying their entry, they encounter the imprisoned Marika. Suddenly released from her bonds, her hair immediately turns red as Radagon assumes control of their shared body and wields Marika's hammer to fight the Tarnished. However, Radagon is unable to defeat them and falls at their hands, with his body being subsumed by the Elden Beast to transform into a large sword, as it emerges to be the Tarnished champion's final challenge.

sources.text:
Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it.
The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

response.answer: Scadutree Fragment được dùng bằng cách tiêu thụ tại các site of grace để nâng Scadutree Blessing của bạn [1][2]. Scadutree Blessing tăng khả năng gây sát thương và giảm sát thương nhận vào của người mang [1][2]. Fragment và cả blessing đều không có tác dụng bên ngoài realm of shadow — hiệu ứng chỉ hoạt động khi bạn ở trong vùng đất của DLC Shadow of the Erdtree [1][2][3].

sources.title: Scadutree Fragment
sources.text: A splinter of the Scadutree that contains golden brilliance. Acquired at the Church of Marika and other places in the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Scadutree Blessing. The Scadutree Blessing bolsters the bearer's ability to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. It is said that when the Scadutree crumbles from its core that it will scatter across the entire realm of shadow. The people of the Erdtree collect the splinters and use them in prayer.

Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Scadutree Blessing.

sources.title: Scadutree Fragment
sources.text:
Scadutree Fragment is a bolstering material in ELDEN RING (2022).
Its effect is only active while you are within the Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC area, the Land of Shadow.
It reduces all incoming damage to the player, while also increasing all damage dealt. When you have collected all of them, the damage increase is equal to 200.5% and the damage decrease is equal to 51.3%.

rows.question: Arsenal Charm hỗ trợ equip load ra sao, và có thể đeo cùng Arsenal Charm +1 hoặc Great-Jar's Arsenal để cộng dồn không?
rows.expected: Arsenal Charm tăng maximum equipment load. Nguồn coi nó là biến thể cùng nhóm với Arsenal Charm +1 và Great-Jar's Arsenal nên không tương thích để đeo cùng; không tự thêm phần trăm tăng nếu thiếu nguồn.

response.answer:
Arsenal Charm tăng tải trọng trang bị tối đa (maximum equipment load) của bạn [2]. Bạn không thể đeo nó cùng Arsenal Charm +1 hay Great-Jar's Arsenal để cộng dồn: cả ba được xem là biến thể của nhau và chỉ một cái được trang bị tại một thời điểm [3][4][5].

Về mức tăng, Arsenal Charm +1 cho +17% Equip Load [4], còn Great-Jar's Arsenal cho +19% Equip Load [5]. Vì chúng loại trừ nhau, bạn chọn một cái phù hợp nhất với nhu cầu của mình.

Mình chưa xác định được phần trăm tăng Equip Load của Arsenal Charm gốc.

rows.question: Moonveil: đòn nhẹ và đòn nặng của Transient Moonlight khác nhau về hướng đánh và tầm ra sao?
rows.expected: Đòn nhẹ quét ngang có projectile tầm ngắn; đòn nặng bổ dọc có projectile tầm trung. Không suy các con số damage hiện tại.

response.answer: Đòn nhẹ là một cú chém ngang (sweep) kèm luồng sáng tầm ngắn, còn đòn nặng là cú chém bổ từ trên xuống (overhead slash) kèm luồng sáng tầm trung — nhờ vậy đòn nặng vươn xa hơn, còn đòn nhẹ rộng hơn và ra đòn nhanh hơn một chút [1]. So với Unsheathe thì khác biệt giữa hai đòn của Transient Moonlight thu hẹp lại nhiều, cả về sát thương lẫn Stance damage, nên lợi thế tầm xa chủ yếu nằm ở đòn nặng [1]. Dù vậy, cả hai vẫn hiệu quả nhất khi đánh ở cự ly cận chiến, vì khi đó cả lưỡi kiếm lẫn luồng sáng đều trúng mục tiêu [1].

sources.title: Moonveil
sources.text:
The Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight is the regular Skill: Unsheathe but with added projectiles: a short-ranged one for the light attack sweep and a mid-ranged one for the heavy attack overhead slash.
The skill is useful in roughly the same ways that Unsheathe is, meaning that the light attack follow-up is generally slightly quicker and much wider in exchange for being slightly weaker, while the heavy attack follow-up hits a single target slightly harder and is slightly more difficult to roll directly away from.
One stark difference is that the different attacks are much less dissimilar, with the light attack follow-up having less of a damage difference (22% less for Unsheathe, 10% less for Transient Moonlight) and much less of a Stance damage difference (50% less for Unsheathe, 8% less for Transient Moonlight).
While this does give the weapon some more reach (though mostly with the heavy attack follow-up), the skill is still the most effective at melee range since that means both the weapon and the magic waves can hit the target.
The skill's heavy attack follow-up has a weird interaction with jumping players and deals a lot less damage against them for some reason.
While a hybrid Intelligence/Dexterity build gains the highest total Attack Power a pure Intelligence build only loses about 2% total Attack Power in exchange for the skill's projectiles getting 13% higher Attack Power, making the latter generally preferable.

rows.question: When Ranni and Godwyn died at the same time, what happened to Ranni's flesh and soul?
rows.expected: Ranni's flesh died while her soul survived. Godwyn, in contrast, died in soul alone.

response.answer: Ranni's body died and her soul lived on. Because she and Godwyn perished in the same instant, the Cursemark of Death split into two half-wheels instead of forming a full circle [4]: Godwyn's soul alone perished, while Ranni became the first demigod to die in the flesh [1][3]. Her spirit was transferred into a doll said to be modeled after her mentor, the Snow Witch — the body she currently uses [5].

sources.title: Rune of Death
sources.text:
Prior to the creation of the Golden Order, the power of the Rune of Death was the source of the power of the god-slaying black flames, which were channeled by the Empyrean known as the Gloam-Eyed Queen from her Godslayer Greatsword. She led the Godskin Apostles, who served Destined Death, until her defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the loyal shadow of Queen Marika the Eternal. Following this, the Rune of Death was sealed away and the true power of the black flame was lost. The sealing away of the Rune of Death was the beginning of the Golden Order, and its power was harbored within Maliketh's black greatsword.
The sealing of the Rune of Death involved removing the fated deaths of the demigods from the Elden Ring, granting them immortality. However, at a later point in history, during the Night of Black Knives, a fragment of the Rune of Death was stolen from Maliketh by Ranni the Witch, who used it to create the godslaying black knives through fearsome rite. On that night, the Black Knife Assassins used the black knives to murder Godwyn the Golden, the first death of a demigod in all history. However, due to Ranni the Witch carving the cursemark of Destined Death into her flesh at the same moment as Godwyn's death, he was unable to die a proper death and perished in soul alone, becoming the Prince of Death. Meanwhile, Ranni's flesh perished and her soul continued to live.
Godwyn was buried below the capital at the Erdtree's roots. The fragment of the Rune of Death spread through the great underground roots of the Erdtree, sprouting in the form of Deathroot, and leading to the birth of Those Who Live in Death.

sources.title: Night of Black Knives
sources.text:
On the night of the plot, the assassins arrived in Leyndell, the Royal Capital, and slew Godwyn the Golden, carving the Cursemark of Death into his flesh. The Cursemark was supposed to form a circle; however, as Ranni perished in the same moment as Godwyn, the mark was split into two half-wheels. Godwyn's soul alone perished, while Ranni became the first Demigod to die in the flesh.
Immediately following the assassination, the Black Knives fled the capital. Tiche, the daughter of the Black Knife Ringleader Alecto, died protecting her mother during the escape.

sources.title: Cursemark of Death
sources.text:
Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch.Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede.
This cursemark was carved at the moment of Death of the first demigod, and should have taken the shape of a circle.
However, two demigods perished at the same time, breaking the cursemark into two half-wheels.
Ranni was the first of the demigods whose flesh perished, while the Prince of Death perished in soul alone.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.section: Background > The Night of Black Knives
sources.text:
Ranni slew her body to evade the Two Fingers
Although the Two Fingers had chosen her as Marika's successor, Ranni did not wish to be a puppet for the Greater Will and resented her Empyrean fate. In order to escape it, Ranni stole a fragment of the Rune of Death from Maliketh, the Black Blade, and through fearsome rite, imbued it into the blades of Numen assassins close to Queen Marika herself. She also gave a fragment to her brother Rykard as a last resort, so he could kill Maliketh if necessary. Ranni plotted for the assassins to kill another individual while she simultaneously killed herself, slaying her own body while the other person died in spirit, thus freeing herself from being an Empyrean.
In what would become known as the Night of Black Knives, the assassins murdered Godwyn the Golden, killing him in spirit, while Ranni killed herself in body, transferring her spirit into a doll said to be modeled after the image of her mentor, the Snow Witch. This marked the step-siblings as the first demigod casualties in history. Ranni's fate and her involvement in the plot remained largely unknown by the denizens of the Lands Between.

rows.expected: Họ là anh em ruột, cùng có cha là Radagon và mẹ là Rennala; Radahn là anh của Ranni.

response.answer: Ranni và Starscourge Radahn là anh em ruột cùng cha cùng mẹ: cả hai đều là con của Radagon (cha) và Queen Rennala (mẹ) [1][2]. Radahn là anh, Ranni là em gái, và họ còn có người anh em ruột thứ ba là Praetor Rykard [3][4]. Lore trong game cũng xác nhận Ranni là con của Radagon với người vợ đầu Rennala, và là em gái của General Radahn cùng Praetor Rykard [5]. Sau khi Radagon rời Rennala để cưới Queen Marika, Ranni và các anh em được nâng lên địa vị demigod dưới danh nghĩa con riêng của Marika [3][4].

sources.title: Starscourge Radahn
sources.text:
Radahn was born the son of Radagon, a champion of the Erdtree, and Queen Rennala, head of both the Carian Royal Family and Academy of Raya Lucaria. He had two siblings, Rykard and Ranni. Radahn inherited his father's flaming red hair, and was fond of its heroic implications. From a young age, he was enamored with the Elden Lord Godfrey. Attempting to emulate his idol, Radahn adorned his armor with lions, the symbol of Godfrey.
At some point, the first Elden Lord, Godfrey, was robbed of grace and hounded from the Lands Between. Radahn's father, Radagon, left Rennala to become Queen Marika's new consort and the second Elden Lord. Radahn and his siblings were thus raised to demigod status by their new step-mother, Marika.
Not wanting to abandon his scrawny but beloved steed, Leonard, Radahn studied gravitational magic in Sellia under a master who was an Alabaster Lord. Radahn befriend the Albinauric Gaius, a senior disciple of his teacher, and the two formed a competitive yet friendly rivalry. Radahn's step-brother Messmer the Impaler was also friends with Gaius and the two became as elder brothers to Radahn.
Mastering gravitational magic allowed Radahn to manipulate the forces of gravity, and to challenge the very stars themselves. Radahn conquered the stars, saving Sellia in the process, using his vast gravitational powers to 'shatter' the stars and arrest their cycles, earning him the moniker of "Starscourge." During this time, he engraved the gravity crest upon his blades.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Ranni as seen in the
story trailer
Originally known as Lunar Princess Ranni, she was the daughter of Radagon, a champion of the Golden Order, and Queen Rennala, head of both the Carian Royal Family and the Academy of Raya Lucaria. She had two older brothers, Radahn and Rykard.
Ranni was also an Empyrean, meaning she had the potential to one day succeed Queen Marika as the divine ruler of the Lands Between. The Two Fingers chose her as a potential successor and granted her a Shadow by the name of Blaidd to be her vassal. He was approved of by Rennala, and was raised as her foster brother. Ranni grew up playing with Blaidd, and they were often accompanied by Iji, a troll blacksmith who served the Carian royals.
Led by the hand of her mother Rennala, young Ranni would encounter her Dark Moon. What she beheld was cold, dark and veiled in occult mystery. Deep in the woods, she would also encounter a snowy crone, known simply as the "Snow Witch", who would go on to become her secret mentor. She was an old witch well versed in cold-based sorceries, and she taught Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her magic. The full Dark Moon, cold and leaden, would become Ranni's sigil and symbol of her power and authority.
At some point, Ranni's father would abandon her mother in order to marry Queen Marika and assume the title of second Elden Lord. Ranni and her siblings were thus raised to demigod status by their new stepmother.

sources.title: Sorcerer Rogier
sources.text:
Greeting after handing over the Black Knifeprint
Ahh, hello. I was hoping to see you.
My examination is complete. Here's the knifeprint back, with my thanks.
Now, I have a fairly good idea who performed the rite upon the blade. The person who orchestrated the Night of the Black Knives.
Lunar Princess Ranni. One of the children born to King Consort Radagon and his first wife, Renalla.
Demigod and sister to General Radahn and Praetor Rykard.
Her's was the name I discovered in the imprint.
Truly, you have my thanks.
But, if I might be so bold, I would also like to ask something more of you.
If Ranni truly is the one who plotted that fateful night,
then she should bear the cursemark of Destined Death somewhere upon her flesh.
I would like you to procure it for me.
And then all will be laid bare. I will have the answers I have sought for so long.
Don't fret, it is entirely in accordance with the guidance of grace.
If you seek to stand before the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord,
The answers you find will surely bolster your chances.

rows.question: Vì sao Fortissax trở thành Lichdragon, và biến cố đó liên hệ thế nào với cái chết của Godwyn?
rows.expected: Godwyn chết về linh hồn và trở thành Prince of Death. Fortissax chống lại Death bên trong người bạn Godwyn nhưng thất bại, rồi bị nó làm tha hóa thành Lichdragon.

response.answer:
Fortissax trở thành Lichdragon vì sau khi Godwyn the Golden biến thành Prince of Death, Fortissax đã chiến đấu rất lâu với "cái chết" nằm trong người bạn đồng hành của mình; nó không thắng được và cuối cùng bị sự tha hóa chết chóc lây nhiễm, trở thành Lichdragon [1][2][3]. Mô tả Remembrance of the Lichdragon cũng xác nhận đúng ý đó: ancient dragon chiến đấu với Death within its companion, không đạt được chiến thắng mà chỉ nhận lấy sự tha hóa [3].

Mối liên hệ với cái chết của Godwyn nằm ở chỗ Godwyn bị ám sát trong Night of Black Knives: linh hồn ông chết, còn thân xác không thể chết thật và về sau biến dạng thành Prince of Death [1][2][4]. "Cái chết" mà Fortissax cố chống lại chính là tình trạng chết-hồn-sống-xác ấy của Godwyn; việc Fortissax thất bại và bị tha hóa là hệ quả của nỗ lực cứu người bạn đồng hành khỏi Death within him [1][2][3].

sources.title: Lichdragon Fortissax
sources.text:
Fortissax is an Ancient Dragon who was once known as the "mightiest boulderstone", known for its use of twin red lightning stakes, and the sibling of Ancient Dragon Lansseax.
During the Age of the Erdtree, the Ancient Dragons warred against the forces of Leyndell, after an assault on the royal capital by the great Ancient Dragon Gransax. Fortissax was challenged by Godwyn the Golden, who fought to the last. Godwyn defeated Fortissax, but he befriended his fallen foe, and their bond gave rise to the Ancient Dragon Cult of the Royal Capital. Through this friendship, Godwyn gained the ability to wield golden lightning, while the dragons gained acceptance as part of the Golden Order.
On the Night of Black Knives, Godwyn was slain by assassins. Godwyn would die in soul alone, with his body condemned to undeath, as it mutated beyond recognition. Fortissax fought long and hard against the death within its companion, becoming corrupted by death in the process. The Lichdragon is encountered within the Deathbed Dream after securing the Cursemark of Death and giving it to Fia, another companion of Godwyn's. Following Fortissax's defeat, Fia gestates the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince, which may usher in an age of death restored.

sources.title: Godwyn the Golden
sources.text:
Godwyn is assassinated during the Night of Black Knives
Godwyn would eventually meet his end during the Night of Black Knives. Seeking to be free from her fate as a pawn of the Greater Will, Godwyn's step-sister Lunar Princess Ranni stole a fragment of the Rune of Death from Maliketh, imbuing the weapons of Numen assassins with it through a fearsome rite. His death was the first recorded death of a demigod, and served as the catalyst for the shattering of the Elden Ring and the subsequent war that broke out between his siblings and stepsiblings.
While Godwyn was believed to be the first dead among the demigods, he and Ranni both died at the same time. As a result, each was branded with one half of the Cursemark of Death. Ranni's flesh perished while Godwyn perished in soul alone. He was buried at the Erdtree's roots below Leyndell, but as he was lacking a soul, his body was unable to die a true death. Some, including his younger half-brother Miquella and his companion Fortissax, tried to cure him of his condition and allow him a proper death, but to no avail. The ancient dragon Fortissax would unsuccessfully try to fight against the Death within Godwyn, but was ultimately corrupted by the blight, becoming a Lichdragon. Godwyn's personal guard became known as the Death Knights, and quested for their master's cadaver surrogates, which would lead them to the catacombs of the Realm of Shadow.

sources.title: Remembrance of the Lichdragon
sources.text:
Remembrance of Lichdragon Fortissax, hewn into the Erdtree.
The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.
Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes.
After Godwyn the Golden became the Prince of Death,
the ancient dragon fought long and hard against the Death within its
companion.
Alas, victory was never achieved and its only reward was corruption.

sources.title: Night of Black Knives
sources.text:
On the night of the plot, the assassins arrived in Leyndell, the Royal Capital, and slew Godwyn the Golden, carving the Cursemark of Death into his flesh. The Cursemark was supposed to form a circle; however, as Ranni perished in the same moment as Godwyn, the mark was split into two half-wheels. Godwyn's soul alone perished, while Ranni became the first Demigod to die in the flesh.
Immediately following the assassination, the Black Knives fled the capital. Tiche, the daughter of the Black Knife Ringleader Alecto, died protecting her mother during the escape.

rows.question: Scadutree Fragment và Revered Spirit Ash tăng blessing cho những đối tượng nào? Hai loại có dùng được ngoài Realm of Shadow không?
rows.expected: Scadutree Fragment tăng Scadutree Blessing cho người mang. Revered Spirit Ash tăng Revered Spirit Ash Blessing cho summoned spirits và spectral steed. Cả hai blessing không có tác dụng ngoài Realm of Shadow; không đánh đồng chúng thành cùng một buff cho người chơi.

response.answer: Scadutree Fragment tăng Scadutree Blessing, giúp người nhận mạnh hơn khi gây và giảm sát thương [1][3]. Revered Spirit Ash tăng Revered Spirit Ash Blessing, giúp cả summoned spirit và spectral steed gây và giảm sát thương tốt hơn [2][4]. Cả hai đều được dùng tại site of grace, nhưng blessing chỉ có tác dụng trong Realm of Shadow và không ảnh hưởng gì bên ngoài [1][2][5].

sources.title: About the Scadutree Blessing
sources.text:
Scadutree Fragments can be found across the realm of shadow.
Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Scadutree Blessing.
The Scadutree Blessing bolsters the recipient's abilities to deal and negate damage, but has no influence outside the realm of shadow.

sources.title: About the Revered Spirit Ash Blessing
sources.text:
SRevered Spirit Ash can be found across the realm of shadow.
Consume this Ash at sites of grace to bolster your Revered Spirit Ash Blessing.
The Revered Spirit Ash Blessing bolsters both summoned spirits' and spectral steed's abilities to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow.

sources.title: Scadutree Fragment
sources.text: A splinter of the Scadutree that contains golden brilliance. Acquired at the Church of Marika and other places in the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Scadutree Blessing. The Scadutree Blessing bolsters the bearer's ability to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. It is said that when the Scadutree crumbles from its core that it will scatter across the entire realm of shadow. The people of the Erdtree collect the splinters and use them in prayer.

sources.title: Revered Spirit Ash
sources.text: Spirit ash of those who came before, infused with potent spirituality. Acquired from the corpses of hornsent and other objects that ritually decorate townships and villages across the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Revered Spirit Ash Blessing. The Revered Spirit Ash Blessing bolsters both summoned spirits' and spectral steed's abilities to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. The withered corpses were called tutelary deities, and Revered Spirit Ash was said to quietly accumulate in the palms of their hands.

rows.question: Tôi muốn vào Nokron để tìm Fingerslayer Blade: cần điều kiện gì, rồi tìm rương ở đâu?
rows.expected: Hạ Starscourge Radahn để mở Nokron; rương chứa Blade nằm phía đông-bắc Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace theo snapshot. Không biến đây thành chỉ dẫn từng ngã rẽ đầy đủ.

response.answer:
Để vào Nokron, bạn phải đánh bại Starscourge Radahn trước; sau đó một ngôi sao rơi xuống Limgrave, tạo ra hố sâu gần Fort Haight, và từ đó bạn đi xuống khu phía trên của Nokron [1][2]. Muốn mở được rương chứa Fingerslayer Blade, bạn còn phải nói chuyện với Ranni tại Ranni's Rise và chọn phục vụ cô ấy ("Serve Ranni the Witch"); nếu chưa làm bước này, rương sẽ chỉ hiện thông báo rằng bạn không phải người được định sẵn để mở nó [1].

Chiếc rương nằm ở phía đông bắc Site of Grace Night's Sacred Ground [3]. Trong khu Night's Sacred Ground, Fingerslayer Blade được giấu bên dưới một hầm ghế đỡ lấy xác của một sinh vật khổng lồ [4].

sources.title: Fingerslayer Blade
sources.text:
The upper section of Nokron can only be reached from a crater near Fort Haight formed after the defeat of Starscourge Radahn.
As the chest can only be opened after selecting Serve Ranni the Witch after talking to her at Ranni's Rise, attempting to interact with it prior to this will prompt the message You are not destined to open this instead.

sources.title: Nokron, Eternal City
sources.text:
One of the Eternal Cities inhabited by the Nox, who were banished underground after invoking the ire of the Greater Will. Nokron houses the Fingerslayer Blade, a blood-drenched fetish made from a corpse which can harm the Greater Will and its vassals, and is proof of the treason of the Nox.
Nokron is notably difficult to access, although a band of slaves-turned-soldiers managed to find their way there, becoming trapped in the subterranean realm after the discover of Ghostflame. While the city is visible from the lower portion of Siofra River, the route to it is only opened after Starscourge Radahn is defeated, which causes a star to fall upon Limgrave, opening a deep crater near Fort Haight.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Completing Ranni's questline will unlock the Age of the Stars ending.
(Optional) Church of Elleh
After meeting Melina and obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle, use Torrent at least once. After that, rest on any Site of Grace. Then, fast travel to the Church of Elleh Site of Grace and find Ranni (using the pseudonym "Renna") sitting on a broken wall. Exhaust her dialogue to receive the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.
If you miss this step, these items will be available for purchase at the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold -- 200 runes for the Lone Wolf Ashes and 1,000 runes for the Spirit Calling Bell respectively.
Ranni's Rise
Ranni can next be encountered on the top floor of Ranni's Rise, accessible by clearing Caria Manor. This stage varies depending on whether you have defeated her brother, Starscourge Radahn, or given Sorcerer Rogier the Black Knifeprint.
Agree to become one of Ranni's vassals, and then head back down the tower to speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis. After speaking to all three, return to Ranni and speak to her again. After this point, if you return to Ranni she will be sleeping, and non-responsive.
Nokron, Eternal City
Nokron can only be accessed after defeating Radahn. Proceed through the area and obtain the Fingerslayer Blade, which is in a chest north-east of the Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace.

sources.title: Night's Sacred Ground
sources.text:
A district within Nokron, Eternal City, accessed by traversing the rooftops south of the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace. A large cathedral-like building can be entered via a window, by climbing across the top of a large gate. The Mimic Tear Ashes can be obtained from a chest behind a door that requires a Stonesword Key to open.
On the lower level is a long street populated by Silver Tears and Mimic Tears, one of which transforms into a Troll. The secret treasure of Nokron, the Fingerslayer Blade, is found below a chair-crypt that props up a vast corpse.

rows.question: During Ranni's quest, what key opens the chest containing the Dark Moon Ring, where is the chest, and how is the key obtained?
rows.expected: The Discarded Palace Key opens the chest in Rennala's boss room at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The quest progression awards the key after defeating the Baleful Shadow beyond the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace.

response.answer: The Discarded Palace Key opens the chest holding the Dark Moon Ring. The chest is in Rennala's boss room, inside the Grand Library of the Academy of Raya Lucaria [1][2][3]. You get the key by defeating the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace, during the Ainsel River portion of Ranni's quest [1]. The Dark Moon Ring itself is the item that unlocks the lift up to the Moonlight Altar and the Cathedral of Manus Celes [1][4].

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Bring the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required for Fia's questline, however it is not necessary to complete Ranni's questline.
WARNING: This will immediately end Preceptor Seluvis's quest.
Ainsel River
Renna's Rise will now be open after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the sending gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.
(Optional) Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline.
Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key. Go to Rennala's boss room in Academy of Raya Lucaria and unlock the chest to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Moonlight Altar
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again and she will disappear, leaving behind the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

sources.title: Raya Lucaria Grand Library
sources.text:
The Raya Lucaria Grand Library is one of the highest points in the Academy of Raya Lucaria located in Liurnia of the Lakes. It is where Queen Rennala was sequestered following her abandonment by Radagon and the subsequent civil war between the sorcerers of the academy.
Here, Rennala cradles the Great Rune of The Unborn nestled in an amber egg, the farewell present from Radagon, and attempts to perfect her art of rebirth. She is surrounded by many imperfect creations, dubbed her "sweetings."
Sellen and Witch-Hunter Jerren will have their final confrontation here, depending on who the Tarnished sides with, either Jerren will remain outside or Sellen will take her place in the inside where she may continue to sell the Tarnished any glintstone sorceries.
There is a single chest in the library, which is locked by the Discarded Palace Key. Within is the Dark Moon Ring needed to complete Ranni's questline and unlock the Cathedral of Manus Celes.

sources.title: Discarded Palace Key
sources.text:
A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh.
Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses.
It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

sources.title: Moonlight Altar
sources.text:
A plateau in the southwest of Liurnia, accessible only by passing through Ainsel River and the Lake of Rot and defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the Void. The lift which leads to the Moonlight Altar is sealed, and can only be accessed by obtaining the Dark Moon Ring from the treasure chest in Rennala's library in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
The plateau, which sits above the Village of the Albinaurics, is the site of the Cathedral of Manus Celes, a large, ruined church. An Evergaol, housing the ringleader of the Black Knife Assassins, can also be found here.

rows.question: Does Samurai's Build Optimization note establish that it is universally the best starting class?
rows.expected: No. It says most efficient in specific circumstances, not universally optimal.

response.answer: No — the note is conditional, not a universal claim. It says Samurai is the most optimal pick for a pure Dexterity build and the most efficient origin for weapons with low Strength requirements, but Vagabond becomes more optimal once a build needs 14 or more Strength [1]. Elsewhere it frames Samurai as the most efficient choice only "in specific circumstances" for minimizing wasted stat points, not for every build [2].

rows.question: Does the stat spread 40 Vigor, 20 Mind, 20 Endurance, 12 Strength, 18 Dexterity, 53 Intelligence, 8 Faith and 8 Arcane match level 100 by the sum-minus-79 rule?
rows.expected: The sum is 179, so it matches level 100 arithmetically. This does not prove optimality, damage or weapon eligibility.

response.answer: Yes. The eight attributes add up to 179, and level equals that sum minus 79, which gives exactly 100 [1].

sources.title: Attribute point accounting
sources.text: A character's level equals the sum of the eight primary attributes minus 79. Thus the target attribute sum is level + 79. Vigor affects HP; Mind affects FP; Endurance affects stamina and equip load. Arithmetic does not establish optimality.
